title: Staff Design Engineer
description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at .

About the role
At Mixpanel , we believe design excellence is a competitive moat. In a world where AI makes it easier than ever to ship, we believe the quality of the experience - how it feels, how it builds trust, how it handles complexity with grace - that separates good products from great ones.
As a Staff Design Engineer at Mixpanel , you'll sit within the design organization and lead the transformation of our design system from a component library into something far more important: the infrastructure that powers how we design, build, and ship in an AI-native world. You'll encode our craft, standards, and vision directly into the systems, tools, and workflows that every designer, engineer, and AI agent in our org builds on.
This isn't a maintenance or systems stewardship role. It's a transformative one. You'll work at the frontier of what design and engineering collaboration looks like when AI writes most of the code, agents prototype from intent, and the design system is less a library and more a living foundation for everything we ship.
You'll be the designer who ships production code. The engineer who holds an uncompromising craft bar. The person who sees the future of how Mixpanel will look and behave in an AI-native world, and builds the infrastructure to make it real.
What you'll do
Build the infrastructure for an AI-native design practice
Translate Mixpanel 's design standards, principles, and taste into systems that live in the code. Build a token system, component library, documentation, and guidelines that AI agents, AI coding tools, and AI prototyping workflows can reliably build on. Evolve our design system to be foundational infrastructure for AI-assisted workflows.
Shape how Mixpanel looks and behaves in an AI-native world
Sit within the product design team and collaborate on reimagining Mixpanel for a world where interfaces are conversational, agentic, and adaptive. You have the rare combination of deep design sensibility and production engineering skills, and you’ll use both to help bring our AI product vision to life with craft and coherence that generic AI outputs can't match.
Own the bridge between design and code
Build systems that connect design to code and keep the two in sync. Define what "shippable" looks like as AI writes more of the code. Work directly in the codebase. Ship PRs that improve the product. Make design a force multiplier for engineering, not a bottleneck.
Stand up prototyping and AI tooling infrastructure
Build the workflows, tools, and infrastructure that let designers and PMs prototype at high fidelity, with working code, real components, and interactive states, without waiting on engineering. Identify the places where design and engineering lose time, intent, or quality in the handoff, and build AI-powered workflows that close those gaps.
Set and model the craft bar
Establish what great looks like - not through documentation alone, but through the quality of what you ship. Enable designers to work more code-adjacent and engineers to build with better components. Stay ahead of how AI is changing EPD workflows and bring that change into the org responsibly.
What success looks like

• The design system is a reliable foundation that AI tools and agents build on, not an obstacle they work around

• Design and code are in sync; the gap between what's designed and what ships is closed

• Designers can prototype at high fidelity without waiting on engineering

• Engineers spend less time on UI polish and rework, more time on features

• The Mixpanel product feels unmistakably itself - cohesive, expressive, and craft-forward - as it evolves

title: Senior SSDLC Security Consultant (3-Month Contract)

Location:

Position Overview

MBC Technology Group (MBCTG) is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented GRC Analyst to support a private-sector client engaged in modern full-stack application development on Microsoft Azure .

This role focuses on integrating security governance, risk management, and compliance practices into the software development lifecycle to ensure applications are designed, built, and deployed securely.

The GRC Analyst will work closely with software engineers, DevOps teams, and security architects to ensure that development practices align with secure coding standards, cloud security requirements, and industry frameworks .

Key Responsibilities

• Support the development and implementation of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices across full-stack development projects.

• Collaborate with software engineers, DevOps teams, and architects to embed security and compliance requirements into development workflows.

• Assist in implementing security controls aligned with frameworks such as NIST SSDF, NIST CSF, and OWASP best practices .

• Participate in secure design reviews, architecture discussions, and threat modeling sessions for applications hosted on Microsoft Azure .

• Assist with documenting and maintaining secure coding standards and application security policies .

• Identify and track security risks related to application development, cloud infrastructure, and third-party components .

• Maintain risk registers, control mappings, and compliance documentation for SSDLC processes.

• Support vulnerability management by helping track remediation activities for issues discovered during code scanning, penetration testing, or security reviews .

• Assist with the implementation and monitoring of Azure security services and controls , including Azure Defender, Azure Policy, and identity management controls .

• Prepare documentation and evidence for security assessments, internal audits, and client compliance reviews .

• Track and report security metrics for development teams , including vulnerability remediation timelines and SSDLC maturity.

Requirements

Experience:

• SDLC: 2 years (Required)

• DevOps: 2 years (Preferred)

• NIST standards: 2 years (Preferred)

• ISO 27001: 2 years (Preferred)

Minimum Qualifications

•
2+ years of experience in cybersecurity, GRC, or application security .

•
Understanding of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) and DevSecOps practices .

•
Familiarity with application security principles , including common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10).

•
Basic understanding of cloud security concepts , preferably in Microsoft Azure environments .

•
Strong documentation, communication, and cross-team collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field .

•
Experience working with software development teams or CI/CD pipelines .

•
Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub, or other CI/CD platforms .

•
Knowledge of security testing tools such as Snyk, Checkmarx, Veracode, or SonarQube.

•
Understanding of threat modeling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE).

•
Security certifications such as Security+, AZ-500, CSSLP, or working toward CISSP or CISA .

Location requirement: Candidates must be currently based in the US or Canada and authorized to work as a contractor in that region.

Benefits

• Work with a modern full-stack development environment hosted on Microsoft Azure .

• Collaborate with experienced developers, architects, and cybersecurity professionals .

• Gain hands-on experience implementing secure development practices in enterprise cloud environments .

• Exposure to clients across healthcare, finance, government, and education sectors .

• Opportunities for professional growth and cybersecurity certification support .

title: Senior Specialist / Manager, AI Safety Data and Evaluation Program
locationText: Cambridge, MA USA; London, UK; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

High-quality safety depends on the right expertise, consistent and repeatable workflows and high levels of interpretability. At Lila Sciences, you will turn scientific risk questions into well-run expert-data and evaluation programs to build this evidence-base.

You will bring a strong working understanding of AI safety and scientific misuse risks to connect internal risk mapping and threat modeling with expertise across Lila and external specialists. Your primary responsibilities will be program execution and data quality: organizing contributors, running red-teaming and evaluation campaigns, and ensuring their outputs meet agreed standards. You will also be responsible for gathering targeted high-impact feedback from partners in the AI Safety community on our different aspects of our approach to Safety. You will work closely with scientists who frame the research questions and interpret their significance, while creating the operational conditions for their expertise to have an impact. Ultimately, you will play a key role in generating the evidence that informs safety decisions made by senior leadership at Lila.

What You'll Be Building

• Translate agreed scientific briefs into executable plans covering tasks, contributor needs, instructions, milestones, quality standards and delivery expectations.

• Source and coordinate external experts with scientific colleagues, and organize access to relevant expertise within Lila.

• Manage contributor onboarding, task assignment, training and support so specialists can contribute effectively and consistently.

• Run expert-data collection, annotation, red-teaming and evaluation programs, tracking progress and resolving delivery problems.

• Establish quality controls covering completeness, consistency, provenance and adherence to rubrics; coordinate calibration, review, disagreement resolution and rework with scientific owners.

• Maintain clear records, versioned guidance and usable datasets, and improve workflows based on quality findings and researcher feedback.

• Identify questions that require scientific judgment and bring them to the appropriate specialists, ensuring decisions are reflected in program materials and subsequent work.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Experience delivering expert-data, research-operations, evaluation or similarly demanding programs involving specialist contributors.

• A substantial working understanding of AI safety, including how threat models, capability evaluations, red teaming and safeguards inform one another. You should be able to interpret a safety research brief, recognize its assumptions and the consequences of data-quality failures, and identify when a question needs scientific escalation.

• Evidence of applying this safety understanding in research, evaluation or expert-data work, including how it shaped the scoping, execution or review of a program.

• Strong operational judgment and the ability to manage dependencies, changing requirements and several parallel workstreams.

• A track record of setting measurable quality standards, detecting recurring problems and improving the processes that produce data.

• Clear communication, careful documentation and the ability to build effective relationships

The Vice President of Development joins Vote Mama at an exciting moment in the organization’s history. Since its inception seven years ago, Vote Mama has grown revenue annually and built a strong base of early supporters. We now recognize the need to diversify and expand our funding base to sustain and fuel future growth.

title: Senior Support Operations Manager
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

As OKX US continues to grow, we are looking for a Support Operations Lead to join our Business Management team, with a focus on leading and coaching our global Customer Support (CS) function to better serve OKX users. Rather than being a direct member of the CS team, you’ll work alongside Operations, Compliance, Product, and Marketing stakeholders to uplift the quality, efficiency, and regulatory compliance of our offshore CS agents.

 

You’ll act as a subject matter expert (SME) for all things within the customer support experience - helping offshore agents understand local customer expectations, regulations, and how to handle issues with care and accuracy. This is a strategic and high-impact role, laying the groundwork for improved CS experience and potentially a local team in the future.

 

 

What You’ll Be Doing

•
Represent the voice of the customer within the business and act as SME for support needs, regulations, and expectations.

•
Coach and guide offshore CS teams to improve handling of tickets, especially regulatory-sensitive cases (e.g., scam/fraud, ID verification).

•
Partner with local Compliance, Operations, and Legal to ensure offshore CS agents are trained and updated on local regulatory requirements.

•
Manage high-priority and escalated customer cases in collaboration with offshore agents and local teams.

•
Liaise with Customer Due Diligence (CDD) teams to improve KYC/AML workflows for customers and reduce customer friction.

•
Act as SME for OKX Card support operations - guiding offshore CS on dispute handling, chargeback processes, and cardholder issue resolution in line with card program compliance requirements.

•
Work closely with Product and Marketing teams to proactively inform CS of upcoming campaigns, changes, or product launches that may drive ticket volume.

•
Identify operational pain points in the customer journey and work cross-functionally to resolve or escalate them.

•
Develop SOPs, quick guides, and training materials to help offshore agents respond more effectively to users.

•
Track key CS metrics such as resolution time, CSAT, and escalation volume to measure success and identify improvement areas.

•
If the business moves toward a local CS team in the future, help scope, plan, and build this function from the ground up.

 

What We Look For In You

Experience & Industry Knowledge

•
5+ years of experience in customer operations, customer experience, or support leadership, ideally within fintech, crypto, or financial services.

•
Solid understanding of US financial regulation, consumer protection expectations, and AML/KYC processes.

•
Experience working with or leading offshore support teams in a high-growth or regulated environment.

•
Exposure to customer-centric operations functions - blending support, risk, compliance, and product feedback loops.

Skills & Competencies

•
Strong leadership and coaching ability, with a focus on raising offshore team performance without direct line management.

•
Excellent stakeholder management skills - ability to work across comp

ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands - including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank - to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

As a Software Engineer Intern, Agent, you'll work directly on production AI agents for Sierra's customers. If you're hungry to shape and learn from the most important technological wave in history, come build at Sierra.

title: Customer Success Manager, SME & Growth
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Own the first 90 days of the customer journey for new French customers, bringing them to their target level of activity as quickly as possible through clear plans, hands-on product configuration and fast blocker removal. You’ll lead onboarding from first KYC approval, working closely with Account Executives, Account Managers, KYC, Support, Risk and Product across a portfolio of customers with different levels of complexity. You’ll help customers configure and activate accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend and payouts, while managing a proactive portfolio of partner-referred customers.

- Take ownership of each customer from first KYC approval, with a clear plan, milestones, owners and the revenue target defined at signature.

- Adapt the onboarding approach to the deal: use a scaled motion for smaller deals, a high-touch approach for larger ones, and partner with the Account Manager on enterprise onboardings.

- Guide customers through account set-up, payments, FX, cards, Spend and payouts based on their use case.

- Remove blockers quickly by coordinating with KYC, Support, Risk and Product, while keeping communication clear and proactive.

- Hand customers over to the Account Manager at day 90 with documented account status, adoption level and expansion signals.

- Reduce the time between first KYC approval and first live transaction.

- Bring each customer to the revenue target set at signature and spot at-risk onboardings early, escalating with context, impact and a proposed solution.

- Run a proactive, scaled motion for partner-referred customers, including onboarding follow-up, usage monitoring and risk detection.

- Keep partners informed about the progress of their referred customers and hand accounts that grow in value or complexity to the Account Manager.

- Contribute to onboarding playbooks, checklists and standard configurations by customer type.

- Keep Salesforce and onboarding tracking accurate and up to date, turning recurring friction into process improvements.

You’ll work from our Paris office a minimum of three days per week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- Experience in onboarding, implementation, customer success or a comparable post-sale delivery role.

- Experience working in a high-pace, high-volume environment, handling multiple onboardings in parallel while maintaining quality and deadlines.

- Hands-on experience configuring a product with customers.

- A strong understanding of financial flows such as payments, FX, payouts, cards, invoicing or reconciliation, and the ability to speak credibly to Finance and Operations teams.

- A track record measured on customer outcomes such as activation, usage and time-to-live, rather than activity.

- Fluency in French and professional English.

- The ability to learn complex products quickly, explain them simply and work across teams without direct authority.

- A proactive, resilient and hands-on way of working.

title: Mechanical Engineer Intern
description:
About Tempo

Based in San Diego, California, Tempo develops thermochemical energy storage (TCES) systems designed for energy-intensive industries. The platform enables industrial operators to shift energy use over time by sourcing power when it is most cost-effective and enables the electrification of high-temperature industrial heat at a cost advantage to using fossil fuels. By storing electricity thermochemically, the system delivers a continuous stream of combustion-free, high-temperature air at up to 1,200°C.

Tempo is backed by leading climate and energy investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Prelude Ventures.

For more information, visit www.tempoenergy.com .

Tempo is looking for extraordinary students to join us as a mechanical engineering intern in Spring 2027. As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within Tempo’s Technology & Innovation (T&I) group, who will help you apply your knowledge and grow your skills on projects that have a significant impact. You’ll also get to have some fun and network with other interns and employees through optional social and professional events.

 

What you’ll do:

• Work within Tempo’s technology & innovation (T&I) test engineering group

title: UX Product Designer
description:
We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.
Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended.

This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it.

Your Role
As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will:

• Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App.

• Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution.

• Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed?

• Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk.

• Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned.

• Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track.

• Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production.

• Help mature our design system in Figma.

You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

• 2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints.

• Experience with B2B SaaS products.

• You start with questions, not solutions: who is the user, what is their context, what problem are we really solving?

• You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production.

• Strong Figma skills.

• Native Dutch speaker. You’ll talk with healthcare professionals a lot, in their own language.

• A portfolio that shows your thinking: the user, the problem, how you approached it and how you measured whether it worked.

Strong candidates may also

• Have worked on AI products.

• Have experience in healthcare, or another regulated environment such as legaltech, regtech or govtech.

• Have worked on a CE-certified or medical device product, and know what that means for usability testing.

• Have experience running usability studies or user interviews.

• Enjoy working with a team for the long run and growing together with a scale-up.

What we offer

• Salary between €4,000 and €4,500 per month, plus holiday allowance.

• Ideally 40 hours per week.

• Travel and lunch allowance.

• Home office budget.

• Lease bike.

• Training budget of €1,500 per year.

• Company MacBook.

• ClassPass membership.

• Pension contribution of 10% and roughly 7% paid by Attendi.

Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive
At Attendi, you’ll work in a small, ambitious team that learns and builds together. We are empathetic, take initiative, dare to experiment, and stand by our work. Making mistakes is okay as long as you learn from them.

Application Process

• Please include your portfolio with your application

• Intro call with Roundr, our recruitment partner

• Interview with a colleague from our design tea

title: Customer Success Manager

Gridware is a San Francisco-based technology company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the electrical grid. We pioneered a groundbreaking new class of grid management called active grid response (AGR), focused on monitoring the electrical, physical, and environmental aspects of the grid that affect reliability and safety. title: L1 Technical Support Agent
description:
About HubSync
HubSync is the AI-enabled workflow platform built for CPA firms by tax veterans. We replace the pile of point tools firms use to run an engagement-letters, data collection, organizers, document exchange, e-sign, e-file, payments, and analytics-with one unified system. Top 25 CPA firms already run on it. Backed by Thoma Bravo, we are rebuilding support around an agentic AI platform that answers routine questions instantly, backed by an in-house team that owns everything that needs a human.
About the Role
As an L1 Technical Support Agent reporting to the Support Manager, you are the first person our customers talk to. You will resolve what you can, triage what you can’t, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks. We are looking for someone with sharp troubleshooting instincts, clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working alongside AI tools to deliver exceptional customer experience during peak tax season and beyond.
What You Will Own

• Pick Up Where AI Leaves Off: Own conversations handed off by the AI agent, resolving them on first contact whenever possible with friendly, clear, and accurate answers.

• Work the Queue with Urgency: Respond within SLA in our ticketing platform, keep tickets moving, and follow up until customers confirm resolution.

• Triage Like a Pro: Troubleshoot common issues across the Engagement Letter Wizard, e-Sign (8879, KBA), Tax Organizer, and Tax Return Delivery modules.

• Clean Escalations: Escalate complex tickets to L2 with complete steps to reproduce, screenshots, and diagnostic details so L2 can act immediately.

• Keep Jira Clean: Set tier, category, and priority correctly on every ticket to ensure operational reporting accurately reflects queue dynamics.

• Make the AI Smarter: Flag wrong or missing AI answers and transform repeat questions into knowledge base articles.

• Capture the Voice of the Customer: Log feature requests and recurring customer pain points through our intake process so Product receives direct signal.

• Coverage When Needed Most: Share rotating on-call weekend and holiday shifts, and flex availability during busy season when timing is critical for CPA firms.

Your First 45 Days

Snowplow is the real-time customer context layer that collects, validates, enriches, and delivers behavioral data for advanced analytics, ML, and AI agent decisioning. Snowplow 's event tracking is leveraged across 2M+ websites and applications globally, processing over one trillion events per month.

More than 250 companies, including Experian, AutoTrader, Strava, Condé Nast, and HelloFresh, rely on Snowplow to build a well-governed, first-party data foundation that powers their customer-facing AI agents, in-session personalization and recommendations, and real-time analytics.

This Opportunity

Snowplow is rebuilding how the company runs its own work, and the Applied AI team owns Firn, the data and AI platform that work runs on, and the engineering standards that go with it. This role is an Applied AI engineer embedded with one business team, the way a site reliability engineer sits inside a product team: your line manager, your code reviewers and your career path come from Applied AI; your backlog and your day come from the team you serve. The Senior Director you report to still ships code.

Your team is Growth, the group inside Marketing that books new meetings for our sellers. Its workflows already produce pipeline: an always-on outbound engine that scores accounts daily and sends hundreds of personalized sequences, a campaign builder that turns an AE's target list into a reviewed campaign, a morning routine that ranks warm contacts by intent signal, enrichment and signal pipelines from Apollo, Vector and reo.dev into Snowflake, and a paid-media loop that adjusts ads. They were built by people close to the work to get results fast, and they did. Now they need an engineer who makes them production grade and keeps them improving.

You take over that estate, make it reliable, and make it better every week. The Director of Growth sets what matters, which is what moves pipeline now. You decide how it gets built and you build it. You work with our data engineers on scoring models and the semantic layer, with the platform engineer on the framework your workflows move onto, and with the Growth Associates and AEs who use what you ship. The engineering standards are Applied AI's; the tempo is Growth's.

• The GTM workflows in production. The outbound orchestrator and its sequences, the campaign builder, the intent-signal routine, the enrichment and signal pipelines, and the paid-media loop. You know how each one runs, what it costs, and what to do when it breaks.

• Review steps before anything sends. Agents that check the list, confirm each signal is current, and review the copy before a sequence goes out, with sampled human sign-off.

• The learning loop. Replies and meetings booked feed back into who we contact and what we say. You instrument the sends, run A/B tests on variants, and show the Growth team which messaging is working.

• Signals and enrichment. The pipelines that bring third-party signals and first-party behavior into Snowflake, the fields the Growth team needs exposed through our MCP tools, and the work with our data engineers that gets them there.

• Skills and routines for sellers. The Claude skills the Growth Associates and AEs run each morning, the campaign tooling, and the short working sessions that get a new team using them.

• Deliverability and suppression. One set of contact rules every sender reads, warm-inbox discipline, and the suppression windows that keep us welcome in people's inboxes.

• Engineering standards on your estate. Version control, alerting, tracing, runbooks and documented handover for every workflow you run, and a steady move of those workflows onto the Firn factory framework.

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team

title: Managing Director - Investigations
description:
NAXO is an blockchain investigations and digital forensics firm trusted by top law firms, corporations, and law enforcement agencies for their most technically complex cases. Our experts have distinguished law enforcement backgrounds, deep technical expertise, and a track record of investigating the most complex crypto and cyber matters since the advent of blockchain technology. The nature of our work ranges from analyzing complex blockchain transaction activity and its underlying technology to investigating criminal activity on the dark web.

About the Role

NAXO is a technical investigations firm working across blockchain, cybersecurity, and the dark web in support of litigation teams, large organizations, and law enforcement. We are seeking an investigations manager to direct complex matters and lead technical teams toward clear, defensible findings.

This role requires technical fluency, but not necessarily a technical background. The ideal candidate may be a technologist, investigator, attorney, or former prosecutor with experience leading complex technical investigations.

You must understand unfamiliar technologies well enough to ask the right questions, translate investigative or legal objectives into technical work, and judge whether that work advances the investigation. You will own the substance and direction of investigations, from challenging assumptions and shaping work product, to ensuring the right work is being done efficiently.

What You Will Do

• Manage complex investigations and litigation-support matters from inbound leads through reporting findings.

• Translate investigative, legal, and evidentiary objectives into clear technical scopes and deliverables.

• Direct technologists, blockchain analysts, forensic examiners, and other specialists to achieve investigative objectives.

• Manage scope, staffing, priorities, deadlines, budgets, documentation, and client expectations.

• Test investigative hypotheses, identify evidentiary gaps and competing explanations, and change direction when warranted.

• Explain complex findings clearly to attorneys, investigators, executives, courts, and other non-technical audiences.

• Ensure methods and conclusions are documented and can withstand adversarial scrutiny.

• Perform hands-on investigative or technical analysis where qualified to do so.

Requirements

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Experience leading complex technical investigations in government, litigation, cybersecurity, digital forensics, consulting, law enforcement, intelligence, or related work.

• Technical fluency: the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies, challenge assumptions, and evaluate conclusions. An engineering background is nice-to-have, but not required.

• Ability to work with technical specialists, knowing when to defer to expertise and when to push back.

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information from multiple sources.

• Experience translating broad questions into investigative plans and concrete steps.

• Organizational skills to keep specialists and workstreams focused on a common objective.

• Sound judgment with confidential information, privileged materials, evidence, and sensitive legal or reputational matters.

Preferred Experience

• Cybercrime investigations, including incident response, threat intelligence, network analysis, and security engineering.

• Digital forensics involving computers, mobile devices, cloud platforms, networks, source code, or other digital evidence.

• Dark web investigations, anonymous communications, open-source intelligence, financial investigations, or complex fraud.

• Blockchain analysis, cryptocurrency tracing, attribution, asset tracing, smart contracts, or use of blockchain analytics platforms.

• Working directly with federal, state, or local law enforcement.

• Assessing expert work, preparing experts for testimony, or examining technical witnesses.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

THE ROLE

Our Product Managers operate like owners of their surface. The APM role is how we develop the next ones.

You join a senior PM's team and own a defined part of a banking product. You ship to real customers in your first quarter. You get real scope, a direct mentor, and honest feedback every week. The goal: in 18 months, you own a surface as a full PM.

In banking, every interaction carries trust. Money moves, cards get declined, payments settle or fail. You learn how a regulated financial product works from the inside, and you learn to build products that customers trust with their money.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own a feature area end to end. Your mentor gives you a defined part of the product. You own it from the problem to the result. Frame the problem, write the spec, ship it, and measure what changed. When the data shows a better direction, bring a recommendation, not only the data.

Build with Design and Engineering every day. Sit with your designer and engineers from the first sketch to the launch. Write specs that engineers want to read. Give clear feedback on flows and edge cases, because in banking an edge case is a customer's money. Unblock the team fast, and run launches end to end. In a regulated product, this also means that you bring Compliance and Operations in early, so they do not block the launch late.

Get close to customers. Talk to founders and finance teams every week. Read support tickets. Learn how early-stage companies think about cash, spend, and risk, and bring that knowledge back to the team.

Decide with data. Define success before you build. Pull your own data. Report clearly what worked and what did not.

Build with AI. Use frontier models to test ideas, build prototypes, analyze customer feedback, and draft specs. We expect AI to make you faster, and we expect you to find new ways to use it for our customers.

WHAT YOU GET

- A named senior PM as your mentor, and a defined scope from your first week.

- Weekly 1:1s and structured reviews at 6 and 12 months.

- Direct exposure to product reviews with leadership.

- A clear path to Product Manager.

WHO YOU ARE

- You have 1 - 3 years of experience in product, engineering, data, consulting, banking, at a startup, or in a customer facing role. Or you started something of your own.

- You are analytical. You are comfortable with SQL, spreadsheets, and numbers, and you check your own work.

- You are curious about how money moves. Knowledge of ACH, card networks, KYC/KYB, or reconciliation is a plus. We teach the rest.

- You use AI every day, and you can show us something you built with it.

- You write clearly. You can explain a complex problem in one page.

- You take feedback well and act on it fast.

- You take ownership. When something is broken, you fix it or you find the person who can.

Nice to have: a technical background or coding experience, work at a bank or fintech, or startup experience.

Our people are our most valuable asset. Our target compensation range for this role is $133K - $160K. Compensation will be determined by leveling and performance throughout the interview process. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, comprehensive healthcare benefits, and paid time off.

title: Technical Co-founder
description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking an applied AI builder to co-found and lead the technical direction of a new B2B AI venture from the ground up. This is a co-founder partnership with founder-level equity and founder-level authority, not a salaried executive role.
We are not looking for someone who manages engineers from a distance or adds AI language to a traditional CTO resume. We are looking for someone who can take a vague problem, frame it clearly, design the right system, and turn it into something customers actually use and trust. If you've gone from ambiguity to working product before - and you want to do it again with the backing of an experienced venture building team - this is the opportunity.
This is a full-time, exclusive commitment to building and owning a single B2B AI venture from the ground up.
About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You'll co-create with a proven venture building team, including:

• John Carbrey - 4x founder, bootstrapped to $100M ARR

• Joshua Auslander - Seasoned CFO and strategic advisor with $200M aggregate exits

• Alan Smith - Globally recognized early stage validation expert, 24 products launched, an exit, 5M+ books sold

• Prathna Ramesh - Early-stage investor and capital strategy advisor

The Partnership

• Founder-level equity with meaningful ownership from inception, aligned across funding rounds

• Founder-level authority, including co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy

• Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

• A proven process and playbook for taking ventures from 0 to 1, informed by our team's prior experience and mistakes

• Venture building and scaling resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

• Investor and advisor network across B2B AI and early-stage capital markets

• A true co-creation model in which you operate as CTO with FutureSight 's cross-functional team as your partner - building alongside you.

What you'll own
As Co-Founder & CTO, you will set the venture's technical direction and lead its execution. This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire.

• Technical Direction - Own problem framing, architecture, system design, and product judgment from day one, translating rough product intent into structure, context, and specs that both humans and AI systems can execute against

• Build - Use modern tools and frontier models to move fast without sacrificing quality or maintainability, designing agentic systems with first-principles thinking and knowing when orchestration adds genuine leverage versus when simplicity is the better call

• Customer & Market - Be the primary technical voice in early customer conversations, understanding real workflows and shaping the right product rather than just shipping quickly

• Traction Before Scale - Prove there is something worth scaling before thinking about scaling it, focusing on traction first and team-building second

• Capital - Contribute to fundraising, from investor conversations to due diligence

• Team - Recruit and grow a technical team when the time is right, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

• Proven track record of shipping AI products to real users under real-world constraints - not research, experiments, or prototypes

• Deep practical experience with frontier models, LLM-based systems, and agentic architectures, with strong system design instincts and a bias for simplicity and maintainability

• Strong translation layer skills - able to turn messy product intent into clear structure, constraints, and specs that both humans and AI systems can act on

title: AI Engineer - Croatia
description:
Space Inch is on a new mission, and we’re looking for AI experts and enthusiasts to join us!
We’re building the next generation of B2B AI experiences , and we need an AI engineer to build, own, and operate production-ready LLM-powered services end-to-end . You will build and operate fast, reliable AI systems that power core platform features, enabling accurate, data-grounded recommendations and intelligent workflows with production-grade performance and reliability at scale.
We’re expanding our team and bringing on multiple teammates to contribute across multiple projects built on this stack.
Our Mission, Vision, and Values
At Space Inch , we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members. Every team member has access to an executive coach as part of this commitment.
About working at Space Inch

• Our team (70+ people) is primarily based in Croatia, with members in South America, Serbia, and the US. While focus is on working remotely, we do have an office in Zagreb for those who prefer a hybrid approach and are located nearby.

• Occasional travel may be required, including annual company retreats in Croatia.

• We work on end-to-end projects with long-term vision

• We strongly support work/life balance for our team members

Requirements
Our ideal candidate's core tech stack:

•
Languages & APIs: Python (FastAPI), TypeScript (Node/Nest BFF), REST/GraphQL, WebSocket/SSE

•
Python + FastAPI production experience (async, dependency injection, testing).

• Comfortable integrating with TypeScript/Node

• Built APIs with REST/GraphQL and at least one streaming pattern ( SSE/WebSocket ).

•
LLM & RAG: embedding stores (pgvector / OpenSearch / etc), chunking strategies, re-rank, hybrid search; prompt tooling & templates; guardrails

•
Observability & quality: structured logging, tracing, metrics; experiment/eval tooling (e.g., Langfuse-style telemetry), offline/online A/Bs

•
Data & pipelines: robust CSV/Sheets ingestion, schema validation, PII handling, backfills, scheduled jobs

•
Agentic experience (not day-one usage): familiarity with MCP and agent frameworks, tool design, constrained execution, and safe planning, so you can leverage them when they’re the right fit

• Can work effectively in CET timezone

Nice to have

• LLM serving optimization (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM), quantization/LoRA know-how

• Retrieval eval frameworks, cross-encoder rerankers, response grading

• Experience with cost controls, token budgeting, and prompt compression

•
Serving & infra: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD; model gateways (e.g., LiteLLM/vLLM) and caching; object storage (S3-compatible); message bus (Kafka or equivalent)

•
Security & privacy: tenant-aware access controls, secrets management, audit logs, privacy and safety red-teaming basics

Qualifications

•
4-6+ years software engineering (product environments) , ideally with hands-on experience in shipping LLM/GenAI to production

• Proven track record owning services end-to-end (design, implementation, rollout, monitoring, and iteration)

• Clear writing, pragmatic decision-making, and comfort collaborating with Mobile, Backend, and Ops (Dev/LLM)

• Experience with technologies

Qualities for success

• Proactive, solutions-driven mindset

• Strong attention to detail and code quality

• Comfortable making technical decisions independently

• Passion for learning and improving

• Ownership mentality, i. e. you care about the end product

Benefits

•
Monthly salary : 4.400,00-5.850,00 EUR gross 1, based on experience and skills

•
Remote-first setup with optional use of our Zagreb office

•
Stay active : Multisport card or wellness subsidy

•
Health & Wellbeing : 100% paid sick leave + annual health checkups

•
Extra perks : Christmas bonus and referral bonus

•
Grow with us : Education budget to fuel learning and professional developm
